title: Dream Believer
meta_description: Dream Believer, a luxury vacation home including a large private pool, putting green, outdoor kitchen, many outdoor gathering spots, and is located close to the beach access. Enjoy the open concept living area, chef's kitchen, and butler's pantry!
description_expanded: AboutDream Believer | Luxury 30A Vacation Rental in Dune Allen Beach with Private Pool, Putting Green and Carriage House Near Beach Access Why Guests Love Dream Believer • Expansive private pool and oversized resort-style lounge deck creating a true backyard oasis • Close to two Dune Allen Beach access points with quick access to sugar-white sand and emerald Gulf waters • Private carriage house ideal for multi-generational families, grandparents, or couples traveling together • Six bedrooms total sleeping up to 12 guests with flexible gathering spaces throughout • Private putting green for relaxed outdoor fun and friendly competition • Gourmet chef’s kitchen with high-end appliances and a spacious butler’s pantry • Two separate living rooms plus an additional lounging area for spreading out comfortably • Outdoor grill, multiple seating areas, and alfresco dining designed for entertaining • Prime Scenic Highway 30A location near Stinky’s Fish Camp, Grand Boulevard, boutique shopping and dining • Golf cart rental perk available with exclusive savings on a street-legal golf cart • Easy access to the 30A bike trail for exploring coastal dune lakes and beach towns • Ample parking for multiple vehicles • Starter kitchen and bath amenities including Starbucks coffee and bottled waters A Luxury 30A Beach House Designed for Unforgettable Vacations Welcome to Dream Believer, a premier luxury 30A vacation rental located in the highly sought-after Dune Allen Beach community along Scenic Highway 30A in Santa Rosa Beach, Florida. Perfectly positioned near two public beach access points, this six-bedroom coastal retreat blends upscale design, resort-style outdoor living, and thoughtful amenities for families and groups seeking a high-end Emerald Coast getaway. If you are searching for a luxury 30A vacation rental with a private pool, carriage house, and close beach access, Dream Believer offers one of the most complete and well-appointed experiences in Dune Allen Beach. Resort-Style Outdoor Living with Private Pool and Putting Green The outdoor spaces at Dream Believer are designed to feel like your own private 30A resort. The expansive private pool is surrounded by an oversized lounge deck with abundant seating for sunbathing, relaxing, and gathering together. Spend your mornings enjoying coffee poolside, afternoons swimming beneath the Florida sun, and evenings dining outdoors under the stars. Additional outdoor features include: • Private putting green for casual fun and friendly competition • Outdoor grill area perfect for seafood dinners and family cookouts • Multiple lounging zones for both shade and sun • Spacious deck layout ideal for entertaining large groups This home is designed for guests who value outdoor living as much as beach access. Open-Concept Coastal Elegance with Gourmet Kitchen Inside, Dream Believer welcomes you with professionally designed interiors that blend coastal luxury with comfort and functionality. The open-concept layout allows natural light to fill the living, dining, and kitchen areas, creating an inviting environment for gathering. The gourmet chef’s kitchen features: • High-end stainless appliances • Generous island with seating • Spacious butler’s pantry for additional storage and prep space • Ample cookware, serveware, and entertaining essentials Whether preparing a casual beach breakfast or hosting a full family dinner, this kitchen supports every type of vacation meal. Multiple Living Areas for Comfort and Flexibility Dream Believer is thoughtfully designed with two separate living rooms plus an additional lounge area, allowing groups to spread out with ease. This flexible layout is ideal for: • Movie nights in one space while others relax elsewhere • Kids and teens having their own gathering area • Quiet reading, remote work, or private conversation • Multi-generational families traveling together The home’s layout makes it easy to enjoy time together while still maintaining personal space. Six Bedrooms Including a Private Carriage House Dream Believer comfortably sleeps up to 12 guests across six bedrooms, making it ideal for large families and group vacations on 30A. The main house includes four beautifully designed bedrooms offering comfort, privacy, and restful spaces after long beach days. The luxury carriage house provides two additional bedrooms, a cozy living area, and a kitchenette. This separate space is perfect for: • Grandparents • In-laws • Couples traveling together • Guests seeking additional privacy The carriage house enhances flexibility while keeping everyone close. Prime Dune Allen Beach Location on Scenic 30A Located in Dune Allen Beach, one of the most beloved communities along Scenic Highway 30A, Dream Believer offers easy access to both relaxation and activity. Nearby attractions include: • Two convenient beach access points • Stinky’s Fish Camp • Grand Boulevard at Sandestin • Scenic 30A bike trail • Coastal dune lakes • Boutique shopping and local dining You are perfectly positioned to enjoy everything from quiet beach mornings to lively evenings out. Frequently Asked Questions How close is Dream Believer to the beach? The home is within easy walking distance to two beach access points in Dune Allen Beach. Does Dream Believer have a private pool? Yes. The home features a large private pool with an expansive lounge deck. Is this home ideal for multi-generational families? Absolutely. With six bedrooms and a separate carriage house, Dream Believer is perfectly suited for extended family stays. Are there entertainment features at the home? Yes. The private putting green, multiple living areas, outdoor grill space, and large pool provide plenty of on-site entertainment. Your Elevated 30A Vacation Starts Here Dream Believer stands out among luxury 30A vacation rentals for its rare combination of private pool, putting green, carriage house, spacious design, and prime Dune Allen Beach location. Whether you are planning a family reunion, a multi-generational getaway, or a refined coastal retreat, this home offers the comfort, space, and sophistication that today’s travelers are searching for on 30A. Reserve your stay at Dream Believer and experience one of the most desirable luxury vacation homes in Dune Allen Beach along Scenic Highway 30A.
